entities.summary: Jean Gaumy is a French photographer and filmmaker who has been associated with Magnum Photos since 1977 who has specialised in depictions of isolated or confined communities and groups. Jean Gaumy was a painters & sculptors from Pontaillac (b. 1948-08-28, Pontaillac). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
